questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 7 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height: ½ × 12 × 7 = 42 cm². Halving is the step that's easy to rush past.
